notes: Audit/qualification bundle: nested pilot and historical comparison measurements are not promoted to primary results.
physical_io_latency_note: Physical disk I/O latency and write-only latency were not measured. E uses scan latency; other workloads use client point-lookup latency.
device_latency_note: Device-layer averages = diskstats accumulated milliseconds / completed requests; includes all processes and in-flight boundary effects. Not NVMe physical latency percentiles.
